def book_reservation(user_id: str, origin: str, destination: str, flight_type: str, cabin: str, flights: list, passengers: list, payment_methods: list, total_baggages: int, nonfree_baggages: int, insurance: str):
    """
    Book a flight reservation for a user.

    IMPORTANT — before calling, you must have shown the user the full booking
    details and received an explicit "yes". When they confirm, call this tool
    immediately in the SAME turn (do not re-ask or re-summarize).

    Passenger date of birth (dob) is ALREADY ON FILE — never ask the user to
    type it and never invent one. This tool auto-fills a missing dob from the
    account holder's profile when the passenger's name matches the account
    holder. For any other passenger, read the dob from an existing reservation
    (get_reservation_details) or the user's saved passengers (get_user_details)
    and pass it here.

    Args:
        user_id: The ID of the user booking the reservation, e.g. 'sara_doe_496'.
        origin: IATA code of the FIRST flight's origin, e.g. 'SFO' (3 letters).
        destination: IATA code of the trip's final destination, e.g. 'JFK'. For a
            round_trip this is the far city you fly to (NOT back to the origin).
        flight_type: Either 'one_way' or 'round_trip'.
        cabin: One of 'basic_economy', 'economy', or 'business'. Must be identical
            for every flight segment.
        flights: List of segment objects, each EXACTLY {"flight_number": "HAT123",
            "date": "2024-05-01"}. One object per segment, in travel order.
        passengers: List of passenger objects, each EXACTLY
            {"first_name": "Sara", "last_name": "Doe", "dob": "1990-04-05"}.
            The dob key must be spelled 'dob' (YYYY-MM-DD). If you leave dob out
            for the account holder, it is auto-filled from their profile.
        payment_methods: List of payment objects, each EXACTLY
            {"payment_id": "credit_card_7815826", "amount": 250}. Use the real
            payment_id from the user's profile (get_user_details) — never a made-up
            id. amount is an integer dollar value; the amounts must sum to the total
            price. At most one certificate, one credit card, and three gift cards.
        total_baggages: Total number of checked bags across the whole reservation.
        nonfree_baggages: Number of those bags beyond the free allowance (each $50).
        insurance: 'yes' or 'no'.

    Returns:
        The created reservation, or an actionable error string.
    """
    def _name_key(first, last):
        return ((first or "").strip().lower(), (last or "").strip().lower())

    def _lookup_user():
        try:
            u = env_get_user_details(user_id=user_id)
        except Exception:
            return None
        return u if isinstance(u, dict) else None

    _cache = {"user": None}  # profile fetched lazily only if a dob is missing

    def _norm_passenger(p):
        if not isinstance(p, dict):
            return p
        q = dict(p)
        # Normalize common wrong dob key spellings to the required 'dob'.
        for alt in ("date_of_birth", "birth_date", "dateOfBirth", "date of birth", "DOB"):
            if alt in q and not q.get("dob"):
                q["dob"] = q.pop(alt)
            elif alt in q:
                q.pop(alt, None)
        # Backfill a genuinely missing dob from the profile (account holder match).
        if not q.get("dob"):
            if _cache["user"] is None:
                _cache["user"] = _lookup_user() or {}
            user = _cache["user"]
            name = user.get("name") or {}
            if _name_key(q.get("first_name"), q.get("last_name")) == \
               _name_key(name.get("first_name"), name.get("last_name")) and user.get("dob"):
                q["dob"] = user["dob"]
            else:
                for sp in (user.get("saved_passengers") or []):
                    if isinstance(sp, dict) and _name_key(q.get("first_name"), q.get("last_name")) == \
                       _name_key(sp.get("first_name"), sp.get("last_name")) and sp.get("dob"):
                        q["dob"] = sp["dob"]
                        break
        if not q.get("dob"):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Missing date of birth for passenger {q.get('first_name')} {q.get('last_name')}. "
                "The dob is on file - do NOT ask the user or guess. Read it from the account "
                "holder's profile (get_user_details) or an existing reservation "
                "(get_reservation_details), then pass it as 'dob' in YYYY-MM-DD format."
            )
        return q

    def _norm_payment(pm):
        if not isinstance(pm, dict):
            return pm
        q = dict(pm)
        if "payment_id" not in q and q.get("id"):
            q["payment_id"] = q.pop("id")
        q.pop("type", None)  # 'type' is not an accepted field; payment_id encodes the source
        return q

    passengers = [_norm_passenger(p) for p in passengers]
    payment_methods = [_norm_payment(pm) for pm in payment_methods]

    return env_book_reservation(user_id=user_id, origin=origin, destination=destination, flight_type=flight_type, cabin=cabin, flights=flights, passengers=passengers, payment_methods=payment_methods, total_baggages=total_baggages, nonfree_baggages=nonfree_baggages, insurance=insurance)
